Commentary.Commentary: That concludes the proceedings for the T20I series. Both these teams will now shift their focus on the 3-match ODI series, starting on 10th July 2022 at 7 pm IST (1.30 pm GMT). Do join us in advance for the coverage. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Nicholas Pooran, the captain of West Indies, is also the Player of the Match for his unbeaten 74 off just 39 balls. He also takes home the Player of the Series award. Starts by saying that he loves Guyana and is happy to perform in front of this crowd. Tells that he would have loved to bat first and get some batting practice but is happy to get two wins under the belt and win the series. He credits Kyle Mayers for his batting and says that he batted quite well absorbing the pressure nicely. Talks about his captaincy, and says that he backs his instincts and asks his teammates to trust him. Says that he may not take popular decisions all the time and shares that the decision to promote Odean Smith was taken because they wanted to utilise his potential completely. Talks about the upcoming series against India and New Zealand and says that they need to follow their process and back their skills.

Mahmudullah, the captain of Bangladesh, says that they had their opportunities and they started well with the ball but the partnership between Mayers and Pooran took the game away from them. Mentions that he was telling his bowlers to stick to the right lines and lengths and try to make them play against the wind. Reckons that they were 10 runs short and credits Litton Das and Afif Hossain for their knocks. Talks about the positives and says that they batted quite well and are batting with positive intent but adds that they need to be better with the ball.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier in the afternoon, it was a much-improved batting show by the touring team. Litton Das found some lost touch while Afif Hossain again showed his worth with the bat. Bangladesh would have hoped for a strong finish but it didn't happen and they fell short by 15-20 runs. That said, looking at the way West Indies demolished the target, those few extra runs would not have mattered much though.

Bangladesh started on a bright note with their army of spin bowlers but failed to maintain the same tempo, especially after the Powerplay. All their bowlers leaked too many boundary balls and the game slipped away from them very quickly. This is now their eighth straight loss across all international matches. A massive soul-searching is needed.

A target of 164 could have been tricky and once West Indies lost their first three wickets fairly cheaply, Bangladesh had the upper hand but the 85-run stand, off just 51 balls, between Nicholas Pooran and Kyle Mayers stole the momentum. The skipper led from the front and played some scintillating shots. Mayers did get out but Nicholas stayed till the end to steer his team home.

A comfortable chase in the end for the home team to close the series 2-0! Yet another thumping performance by them, especially with the bat when the chips were down. Credit goes to Nicholas Pooran and Kyle Mayers for their superb knocks. They batted with authority and made a complete mockery of the target.

SIX! Pooran finishes it off in style! Flighted delivery, full and around middle, Nicholas Pooran shimmies down the track and clubs it over the bowler's head for a maximum. West Indies win by 5 wickets!
A touch short and around off, holding its line, Akeal goes back to punch but edges it down to third man for a run. Scores level.
Mahmudullah decides to bring himself on with just 2 needed to win.
Flatter and wide outside off, Akeal hits it firmly to sweeper cover for one.
Advances down the track to a full ball and drives it down to long off for a run. 3 more needed.
SIX! High and handsome! Loopy and full, outside off, Nicholas Pooran latches onto the room and smites it inside-out over extra cover.
Flighted and outside off, Akeal slices his drive through point for a single.
Akeal Hosein walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Afif Hossain darts it in full, wide outside off, Rovman Powell hurries down the track and has to reach out for it. His intention is to smash it over long off but the ball comes off the toe part of his willow and goes flat to the fielder in the deep. Litton Das times his jump to perfection and takes a fine catch. Too late for Bangladesh though. Only 11 needed off 16 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Litton Das b Afif Hossain

Commentary.Commentary: Full and flighted, outside off, Rovman allows it through.
Wide! Slips a quicker one down the leg side, Powell leaves.
Change in bowling. Another spinner into the attack now. Afif Hossain comes onto bowl the 18th over.
Flighted and outside off, Powell mistimes his paddle scoop towards backward square leg. He gets a single. West Indies are two big blows away!
Arm ball, full and around off, Rovman Powell defends it off the front foot to covers.
Loopy and full, around off, Powell goes down to play the paddle scoop but misses. It turns past his bat and beats the keeper as well. They collect two byes.
A touch short and on middle, Pooran goes back and wrists it behind square leg for a run.
Uses his feet to flick it on the full but finds mid-wicket.
FOUR! Pooran is on fire! Fuller and around leg, Nicholas Pooran kneels down and slog-sweeps it handsomely over backward square leg. Unstoppable.

Change in bowling. Shakib Al Hasan is back to bowl his second over. He took a wicket in his first delivery but was then kept out of the attack by his skipper with two left-handers batting in the middle. However. with a right-hander Rovman Powell at the crease now, Shakib is back.
Full and close to leg, Powell tries to flick but misses. 20 needed off 24 balls.
Forces this one down to long on and takes a single.
Quicker on middle, helped towards short fine leg for a run.
Aerial but safe. Flatter and shorter on middle, Pooran goes back to pull but it takes the bottom part of his bat. It flies behind the bowler and falls in no man's land. They cross.
Flatter and shorter around leg, Powell punches it down to long on for one.
Around leg, tickled behind square leg for a couple.
FOUR! Nicholas Pooran is looking to finish the chase in a hurry. Tossed up again on middle, Pooran uses his feet and lofts it over the bowler's head to the long on fence for another boundary.

SIX! Pooran reaches his half century in style. This is tossed up on middle, Pooran goes on one knee and slog-sweeps it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie. He is truely leading from the front.
Rovman Powell, the finisher, walks in next. 36 needed off 32 balls.

OUT! CAUGHT! Finally a breakthrough for Bangladesh! They needed this badly and Nasum Ahmed has provided it. This is slightly slower through the air, on middle. Mayers looks to launch it down the ground. However, he gets it away off the toe end of his blade and the ball goes in the air towards wide long on. It goes very high and Mahedi Hasan comes running across from the deep to take a fine catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Mahedi Hasan b Nasum Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: A fuller delivery on middle. Pooran knocks it down to long on for a single.
SIX! West Indies are doing this easily now! Nasum Ahmed with another flatter delivery on middle. Nicholas Pooran gets low and powers his sweep over deep square leg for a maximum.
WIDE! Ahmed delivers it at 90 kph but ends up bowling it down the leg side. Pooran looks to pull it but misses.
Pushed quicker on middle. Mayers drives it gently towards covers for a single.
Nasum Ahmed comes back to bowl his last over. 1 for 25 so far from him.
Full and on middle and leg, Mayers works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Floated around the leg stump, Pooran knocks it to mid-wicket for a run.
Quicker and on middle, Mayers guides it past the bowler towards long on for a run.
Pushed quicker on middle again. Pooran works it towards the leg side and takes a single.
This is fuller on middle. Mayers knocks it down to long on for a single.
Mosaddek Hossain is back on.

SIX! FIFTY for Kyle Mayers! His first in T20Is! Gets to the landmark with a top-class shot! An attempted arm ball on middle at 103 kph. Mayers stands still and smashes it straight down the ground for a biggie.
Full toss onto the stumps, Mayers punches it to extra cover for a single. 15 from the over, West Indies are on the charge!
SIX! Boom! Fuller in length and outside off, Kyle Mayers flexes his biceps and thwacks it over long off for a biggie. That hit takes Mayers to his highest score in T20Is.
Short again on middle, Mayers ducks underneath it. It's called a wide for height.
Slower ball on a length outside off, Pooran knocks it to point and they get across for a single.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Rahman bowls it short on middle. Pooran gets into his position early and pulls it towards the backward square leg fence for a boundary.
Good change of pace. It is a slower full-length delivery, outside off. Mayers tries to slash it away but gets a thick outside edge to the short third man fielder. They cross.
A low full toss on off. Pooran opens his bat-face and guides it to the right of backward point. A single is taken as the fielder stops it inside the ring.
Mustafizur Rahman is back on. He went for 12 runs in his opening over.
Short again outside off, Pooran pulls it through square leg for a run. 13 from the over, West Indies are scoring freely.
On a length outside off, Mayers guides it to third man and rotates the strike.
SIX! That is massive. Shoriful Islam bangs this one short outside off, Mayers smokes it over the deep square leg fence for a biggie.

Ohh... Shoriful Islam misses his shy at the bowler's end, if he would have hit that, Pooran would have been sent packing. It is a slower short ball on middle. Mayers is early on his pull shot and gets hit on his body. The ball rolls towards the off side and Pooran looks for a single. However, Mayers sends him back. Pooran slips as he tries to turn back but Shoriful Islam misses his shy at the bowler's end and that allows Nicholas the opportunity to come back into his crease.
On the shorter side again on middle, Pooran pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Another over that starts with a boundary! Shorter in length and outside off. Enough room for Pooran to free his arms as he cuts it past backward point for a boundary.
Shoriful Islam comes into the attack.
Full and on middle, Nicholas Pooran sweeps it through square leg for a run.
On a length and on middle, Pooran blocks it back to the bowler.
Fuller delivery on the pads, Mayers flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Wide again. Mosaddek Hossain is struggling with his line, this one is fired down the leg side. Pooran tries to play at it but misses.
This is fuller on off. Pooran drives it through covers for a single.
A flatter delivery on off. Pooran defends it towards the off side.

FOUR! A boundary to start the over! This is full on the pads. Pooran skips down the track and looks to clip it. It seems that he missed it to the naked eye but the umpire thinks that he got a bat on this one and gives it as a boundary as the ball races away towards the fine leg fence.
Bowling change. Mosaddek Hossain returns to bowl his second over.
Quicker delivery on off, Pooran drives it firmly to long off for a run. 92 needed at the halfway mark.
Floated and outside off, Mayers punches this through covers for a single.
Slower through the air around leg, Mayers knocks this one to the leg side.
Around off and Pooran reaches the pitch of the ball as he advances down the track. He forces it down to long off for a single.
Slower in the air on off. Pooran with a solid front-foot defense this time.
A flatter and quicker one on middle. Mayers punches it straight down the ground and takes a single as the fielder at long off cuts it off.
Mahedi Hasan to bowl out. 1 for 17 for him, so far.
Short again outside off, Nicholas Pooran gets on top of the bounce and works it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Slower delivery on a length and outside off, Mayers guides it to short third man and get across for a quick single.
Bangs this one short outside off, Nicholas Pooran pulls this to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fizz with a trademark slower delivery this time! Lands it on a length and outside off. Pooran tries to pull it but ends up missing it completely.
Mustafizur Rahman goes fuller again, around off. Pooran fetches it from there and slogs it wide of long on. He comes back for the second run as well, good running.
SIX! Pacer comes into the attack and Pooran sends this over the fence straight away! This is full on off. Pooran skips down the track and launches it over long off for a maximum.
Time to feed some pace. Mustafizur Rahman comes into the attack. Expect him to bowl a lot of cutters on this surface.
Quick and full on leg, Mayers digs this one out well.
Slower through the air on leg, Pooran pushes it through mid on for a single.
Floated around off, Mayers smashes it to long on for a run.

SIX! Wow! What a shot! It is tad shorter on middle. Mayers just stays in his crease and lifts it down the ground with a straight bat for a maximum. He is a brilliant player of spin and will be a key player for the Windies here!
Slightly shorter on middle. Pooran goes back and works it towards square leg for a single.
Tossed up on off. Pooran skips down the track and defends it towards the short cover fielder.
Bowling change. More spin from Bangladesh. Mosaddek Hossain to roll his arm now.
Full and on leg, Pooran flicks it to short fine leg for a run. A successful start for Shakib.
Beautiful delivery! Quick and outside off, Pooran tries to defend off his front foot but gets beaten by the late spin. It just beats his outside edge.
Quicker and full on middle, Mayers guides it to mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Shakib bowls it full but down the leg side. Mayers tries to flick but misses.
This is full on off again. Mayers drives it to the cover fielder this time.
This is full and outside off. Pooran drives it to sweeper cover and takes a single.
Nicholas Pooran arrives. 121 runs needed in 83 balls.

OUT! LBW! Shakib Al Hasan strikes with his first ball and the decision to promote Odean Smith has not turned out to be a fruitful one for the Windies! Shakib Al Hasan delivers a full ball on middle with the angle. Smith goes for a big sweep but misses. The ball hits his back leg and there is an appeal. The umpire raises his finger and Smith does not even bother to review as it looks dead straight. Spinners are doing the trick here for Bangladesh.
Bunts this one to mid off and steals a run. At the end of the Powerplay, West Indies are 43 for 2. Bangladesh were 44 for 2 at the same stage.
Wide! Another flat ball, down the leg side, Smith attempts to flick again but misses.
Shakib Al Hasan is into the attack now.
Wide! Drifting down the leg side, Smith tries to flick but misses. He leaves his crease in the process but Nurul Hasan fails to gather the ball. A stumping chance goes begging.

The bowler senses the charge and delivers it full around leg, Mayers walks forward but fails to flick. It goes off his pads to the leg side and they cross. The fielder tries to have a shy at the striker's end but hits Odean Smith instead.
Quicker one, on middle, punched down to mid on.
FOUR! Up and over the infield! Short and around middle, Mayers goes deep inside the crease and pumps it over the mid on fielder for a boundary.
Walks down the track and pushes a full ball to covers.
Skidding in from around off, Kyle defends it off the front foot.
Fires it flat and on middle, sticking off the surface a bit, Mayers goes back to punch but mistimes it a bit aerially to mid on. They cross. 11 from the over.

SIX! Out of here! A massive blow! Nasum Ahmed decides to toss it up and lands it full around off, Kyle Mayers gets the chance to align himself behind the line as he rockets it down the ground over long off.
FOUR! This will release the pressure. Nasum Ahmed is way too short this time, around leg, Kyle Mayers camps back and muscles it behind square leg for a boundary.
Shortish and on off, Mayers goes back and punches it to covers.
This one holds on the surface a bit, around off, Mayers is early into the shot and misses.
Flatter through the air, on middle, Mayers defends it from the back foot.
A long hop around off, Kyle Mayers pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single. End of a fantastic over from Mahedi.
Flatter and shorter around leg, Kyle goes back and pushes it to mid on.
Fuller and around off, Smith slogs it down to wide long on for a single.
Loopy and full, around off, Odean Smith defends it off his front foot.
An interesting move from West Indies here, Odean Smith walks out at number 4!

OUT! TAKEN! Mahedi hurls it in flat, short and on middle, Shamarh Brooks bends his back knee and goes for the pull shot but fails to keep it down. Anamul Haque is placed at backward square and he is alert to take the catch. West Indies are in an early spot of bother. They are 22 for 2.
Commentary.Howout: c Anamul Haque b Mahedi Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: Fullish and on the pads, Brooks flicks but finds the short fine leg fielder.
Slower through the air, short and on middle, Brooks goes back and works it in front of square leg for a quick run.
Quicker again, around off, defended to the off side.
Flatter arm ball around off, Shamarh Brooks defends at the last moment off his front foot.
FOUR! Bang! Nasum Ahmed fires it flat and full on middle, Brooks finds it in his range and powers it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Turn and bounce from around off, Brooks pushes inside the line as he attempts to defend and gets beaten.
Shortish and around middle, Brooks goes back and pushes it towards the leg side.
Short and outside off, turning away late, Mayers punches it from the bottom half of his blade to extra cover.
Fuller this time, around off, Brooks leans forward and knocks it down to wide long on for a run.
Quicker through the air, flat and short on middle, Brooks goes back and helps it to deep mid-wicket. Calls for two and gets two.
FOUR! Shot! Loopy and full outside off, Shamarh Brooks takes his front leg forward and lofts it over mid off for a clean boundary.
Fuller and around off, driven to extra cover.
On middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Shamarh Brooks walks out at number 3 and it will be spin from both ends from Bangladesh. Mahedi Hasan to start from the other end.

OUT! CAUGHT! Nasum Ahmed closes the over with a wicket. A touch slower this time, full and around middle, Brandon King tries to flick it on the leg side but fails to close the face of his bat in time. He ends up mistiming it in the air towards mid on where Mahmudullah takes a simple catch at the edge of the ring. King cannot believe it and walks back distraught. 155 runs needed in 114 balls.
Skidding down the leg side, Mayers nudges it to short fine leg for a single.
Very full and on middle, King eases it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Too full again, around leg, Brandon tries to flick but misses.
Flatter and shorter, around off, punched to covers.
SIX! Brandon King is away in style! Quicker one, full and around middle, King kneels down and smokes it all the way over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Wide! Starts by firing a full ball down the leg side, King tries to sweep but misses.
